0022600002.text: The Philadelphia 76ers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the New York Knicks, and both teams are still waiting to play their first game of the season. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 before the Knicks beat Philadelphia 4-0 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 144-114 win on May 10. Ariel Hukporti is out for Philadelphia with a ruptured Achilles, while Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons and VJ Edgecombe are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and New York's Josh Hart is also day-to-day with a game-time decision because of ankle soreness.
